jobs.title: VP, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
Overview

The Vice President, Growth Marketing is responsible for driving growth strategies across the Sun Communities and Sun Outdoors brands through partnership with property and operations leaders. Additionally, they are responsible for leading the Growth Marketing Business Partner team, translating business objectives into integrated marketing plans, and coordinating cross-functional marketing efforts to achieve occupancy, revenue, and demand generation goals. This role operates as the leader of an in-house agency, with the Growth Marketing team serving as strategic business partners to property and operations leaders. By building strong stakeholder relationships, understanding business objectives, and developing tailored strategies, the team aligns and mobilizes Marketing Centers of Excellence to deliver measurable results.

Job Duties

- Sets the growth marketing strategy that drives measurable business outcomes across the property portfolio — occupancy, revenue, brand demand, and customer acquisition and retention. (Essential)

- Leads the Marketing Business Partner team as the trusted, peer-level partner to property and field leadership, understanding their goals deeply enough to anticipate needs rather than simply respond to requests. (Essential)

- Translates business needs into clear briefs and mobilizes the Centers of Excellence (Brand & Creative, Performance/Digital, and MarTech) into one integrated activation, conducting the marketing engine rather than owning individual channels. (Essential)

- Builds and runs integrated go-to-market plans that connect brand, demand generation, and marketing technology into cohesive campaigns tied to business results. (Essential)

- Establishes portfolio priorities and marketing plans based on property performance, business objectives, and market conditions. (Essential)

- Coordinates team member selection and development and ensures team members comply with appropriate policies and procedures.

- Monitors marketing performance, reports growth impact to leadership, identifies opportunities for improvement, and recommends corrective actions to keep plans on track to occupancy and revenue targets.

- Leads marketing planning and resource allocation activities to maximize business results and operational efficiency.

- Forecasts changes and communicates potential issues and opportunities affecting portfolio performance.

- Facilitates a positive and collaborative work environment among property, operations, and marketing teams.

- Provides input into marketing strategy and strategic planning as a member of the marketing leadership team.

- Other duties and special projects, as assigned.

Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field (Required)

- 10+ years in experience in marketing, growth marketing, account management, or related experience (Required)

- Must have a valid driver's license

- Strong organizational, marketing, and strategic planning skills

- Ability to analyze data and identify opportunities to improve business performance

- Ability to creatively solve problems and recommend effective solutions

- Excellent communication and presentation skills

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into actionable marketing plans

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, CMS platforms, Google Analytics, and marketing reporting tools

- Experience partnering with business leaders and cross-functional teams to drive results

- Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholder relationships

- Experience leading marketing planning and resource allocation activities

- Agency, consulting, or client-facing marketing experience

- Experience in hospitality, real estate, retail, or other multi-location business environments

BENEFITS

At Sun Communities, you will be part of an industry-leading organization where you will be challenged, inspired, rewarded and transformed. We place a high priority on our team members, and this is a big part of what sets us apart. We will ask you to give us your very best every day, and will challenge you with interesting work, stretch assignments, a collaborative and supportive work environment and plenty of learning and growth. In exchange, we will reward you with great pay, advancement opportunities, paid time off, great benefits, and flexibility.

jobs.title: Procurement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

The Procurement Program Manager is the critical link between strategy and execution within Sun’s supply chain — the role that ensures sourcing decisions translate into operational reality at the property level and that supplier commitments are honored long after contracts are signed. Reporting to a Category Manager, the Procurement Program Manager is the primary coordinator for all supplier-related activities within assigned categories. This role owns the day-to-day management of Sun’s preferred and strategic supplier relationships: facilitating business reviews, compiling and tracking performance scorecards, monitoring supplier risk, managing the contract repository, and delivering the value expected for the enterprise.

Job Duties

- Prepare and compile supplier scorecards, consolidating performance data across service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and contractual objectives for Category Manager review. (Essential)

- Serve as the primary day-to-day relationship point of contact between the procurement team and assigned suppliers; manage ongoing communication cadences. (Essential)

- Monitor supplier risk across financial, environmental, social, and governance (ESG), and cybersecurity dimensions; flag emerging risks and recommend mitigation actions to the Category Manager. (Essential)

- Escalate and manage remediation of systemic supplier issues, documenting corrective action plans (CAPAs) with clear owners and due dates, and tracking them to closure. (Essential)

- Manage the contract repository for assigned contracts, ensuring contracts are current, properly filed, and accessible within the enterprise platform (e.g., Coupa). (Essential)

- Track contract renewal and expiration dates; proactively alert the Category Manager of upcoming actions to prevent unintended auto-renewals or lapses. (Essential)

- Ensure accurate representation of sourced products and services within procurement catalogs and buying policies. (Essential)

- Institute supplier development and continuous-improvement programs with key suppliers, including improvement targets and joint action plans.

- Surface new savings, service, and innovation opportunities that arise through ongoing supplier management and hand off sourcing opportunities to the sourcing team.

- Ensure suppliers comply with negotiated terms, pricing, and obligations; identify and report value leakage.

- Leverage enterprise spend visibility and procurement platforms to inform performance decisions and provide data-driven insights to the Category Manager.

- Prepare executive-level reports and present supplier performance and program outcomes as directed.

- Coordinate cross-functional involvement from operations, accounting, IT, and other departments to validate needs and secure alignment for program activities.

- Support the Category Manager in preparing materials for category reviews, business cases, and stakeholder presentations.

- Provide input and subject-matter context to category strategy, spend analysis, sourcing execution, contract drafting, managed supplier onboarding, savings tracking and validation, compliance and audit support, and procurement policy development.

- Facilitate business reviews (monthly operational reviews and quarterly business reviews [QBRs]) with preferred and strategic suppliers, coordinating agendas, participants, materials, and follow-ups.

- Coordinate supplier offboarding and transition activities when suppliers are exited, ensuring continuity of service across affected properties.

Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, or related field (Required)

- Master's Degree (Preferred)

- 5 years in experience in supplier/vendor performance management, or procurement program coordination (Required)

- 5 years in experience in supplier relationship management, or contract management. (Required)

- Must have a valid driver's license

- Demonstrated experience building scorecards, managing SLAs/KPIs, facilitating QBRs, and driving supplier corrective-action and improvement plans.

- Experience coordinating supplier programs or cross-functional initiatives, ideally across a multi-site or portfolio environment.

- Strong understanding of procurement lifecycle and category management concepts, sufficient to support strategy execution without owning sourcing or contracting.

- Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; ability to influence without authority and build trust with business partners and suppliers.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to performance management and reporting.

- Strong proficiency in Excel, data analytics tools, and procurement platforms (e.g., Coupa).

- Ability to develop supplier evaluation criteria, scorecards, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses.

- Familiarity with supplier risk frameworks (financial, ESG, cybersecurity) and contract lifecycle management.

- Experience in real estate, property management, or portfolio-based operations environments a plus.

- Preferred Certifications/Licensures:(Project Management Professional (PMP))

- Preferred Certifications/Licensures:(Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM))

- Preferred Certifications/Licensures:(Chartered Institute of Procurement and Supply (CIPS))

- Preferred Certifications/Licensures:(Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM))

BENEFITS

We will ask you to give us your very best every day, and will challenge you with interesting work, stretch assignments, a collaborative and supportive work environment and plenty of learning and growth. jobs.title: Asset Management Associate
jobs.description:
Overview

The Asset Management Associate will support the financial and operational performance of a portfolio of MH and/or RV assets through detailed analysis, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration and will work alongside the Vice President, Director, and Senior Vice President on initiatives to support departmental goals. Working both within and across various departments, including FP&A, Revenue Management, Operations, Marketing, and Utility Management, this role will assist in tracking asset performance, identifying trends, and supporting the team’s strategic decision-making to maximize asset performance. The Asset Management Associate will also contribute to the development of internal systems designed to memorialize and manage critical asset-level data.

Job Duties

- Assist in development and review of annual budgets and business plans. (Essential)

- Collaborate with Operations on occupancy trends and Revenue Management to monitor pricing strategies and revenue optimization. (Essential)

- Coordinate with Utility Management on expense performance, conservation initiatives, and supporting infrastructure investment (capital expense) analysis. (Essential)

- Support regular portfolio reviews, business updates, and cross-departmental reporting initiatives. (Essential)

- Assist in building internal systems to capture, store, and manage key asset-level information, including financial, operational, and capital data. (Essential)

- Consolidate and validate actuals, budgets, and forecasts for key performance indicators across assigned assets.

- Conduct monthly variance analysis, highlighting risks and opportunities to the broader Asset Management and Operations teams.

- Work closely with Marketing to track campaign performance and provide recommendations on local marketing strategies.

- Participate in ad hoc analyses and special projects as required by leadership.

Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, or related field (Required)

- 2 years in experience in asset management, real estate finance, or FP&A (Required)

- Must have a valid driver's license

- Strong analytical and Excel modeling skills; familiarity with reporting systems (e.g., Adaptive Insights, Yardi, or similar)

- Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment

- Exposure to or interest in systems development and data organization tools (e.g., SharePoint, Airtable, CRM platforms)

The Vice President, Strategy and M&A is responsible for leading new acquisition identification and sourcing, market research and analysis, providing analysis to support future investment strategy, developing and maintaining relationships with industry contacts, community owners, and brokers, and assists the Senior Vice President of Strategy and Investments with deal negotiations and production of transaction agreements. Additionally, the position will support the Senior Vice President of Strategy and Investments with review of deal underwriting and valuation, financial due diligence, financial modeling, and will assist in closing processes for all potential and active acquisitions and dispositions as directed.
